Rich ivory robe back with warm-gold cloud trim and central vertical gold lightning motif, short gold shoulder accents, navy-violet inner cuffs and short puffy trousers, gold sash ornaments and turquoise beads/tassels, white ankle wraps and stout dark navy/gold boots. LEFT thigh from screen-left hip comes forward away-left, LEFT knee bent, LEFT boot tucked upward behind lower robe around shin height, clearly airborne, two distinct knees. Ensure the two legs have genuine connected hips, knees and ankles with correct near/far overlap. Natural robe tails lift only enough to see two opaque separate boots; small cloth/tassel swing, head and body stable, no huge bob.

Clear empty margin all sides, no cropping any staff/ribbon/boot. Fixed character/head/prop scale consistent across16 frames, not enlarged to fill the canvas. Crisp highest-available clean painted detail, true transparent background, preserve intentional navy-purple cloth but no magenta contamination, rim glow, checkerboard, shadow, floor, text, grid.
